pilot_pr.note: First paint-vm-ascii consumer; established the PaintGlyphRun-per-line pattern and the CliBuilder argv[0] convention gotcha (see lessons.md, 'C#' section).

known_gotchas: CliBuilder.Parser expects argv[0] to be a program name (C/Go convention); language's real args must be prepended with a placeholder, not passed raw.

LoadCow-equivalent file-path building from a user-supplied cowfile flag needs path-traversal / rooted-path-override protection (see cowsay.cs LoadCow for the pattern: GetFileName-only + reject rooted + verify containment).
paint-vm-ascii's glyph_run treats glyph_id as a literal Unicode code point (ASCII-backend-specific relaxation), not a font-internal glyph index -- see spec section 3.1.
Output must be verified byte-identical against an existing port (e.g. Go) for several flag combos, modulo paint-vm-ascii's spec-mandated trailing-blank-line trimming.
Gradle (java/kotlin): must redirect build output away from build/ (collides with BUILD file on case-insensitive filesystems) -- see lessons.md Gradle entries.
Swift on Windows needs the winget toolchain + vcvars setup -- see memory 'Swift on Windows setup'.
Lua rockspecs must pin immutable refs (tag/SHA), not moving branch tips -- see lessons.md Lua section.
